verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a broad REST API for accessing and changing account configuration, including users, notification rules, incident workflows, on-call lookups and incident creation. It also publishes OpenAPI schemas for its public APIs and offers SCIM and MCP interfaces. Nothing in the evidence states that the API matches everything the UI can do, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party UI/API parity claim, API coverage for newer UI features (PIRs, Status Pages, AI agents), independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The REST API provides a way for third parties to connect to a PagerDuty account and access or manipulate configuration data on that account.
add and configure users on a PagerDuty account, including how they're notified by PagerDuty - set up workflows for responding to incidents - find out who is on call and when they're being notified
manually create an incident without an associated monitoring tool
